  {A : Finset G} (hX : Measurable X) (hA : A.Nonempty) {r : ℝ} (hr : ρ⁻[X ; μ # A] < r)
  [inst_3 : IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace G] [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology G] (μ₀ : Measure G)
  (hPμ₀ : IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀)
  (habs : ∀ (y : G), (Measure.map (Prod.fst + Prod.snd) (μ₀.prod (uniformOn ↑A))) {y} = 0 → (Measure.map X μ) {y} = 0)
  (h₀ : KL[X ; μ # Prod.fst + Prod.snd ; μ₀.prod (uniformOn ↑A)] < r) :
  let μ₀P := ⟨μ₀, hPμ₀⟩;
  ∀ (u : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞),
    (∀ (n : ℕ), u n ∈ Ioo 0 1) →
      Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 0) →
        let ν := fun n => (1 - u n) • μ₀ + u n • uniformOn univ;
        IsProbabilityMeasure (uniformOn univ) →
          ∀ (P : ∀ (n : ℕ), IsProbabilityMeasure (ν n)),
            let νP := fun n => ⟨ν n, ⋯⟩;
            Tendsto νP atTop (𝓝 μ₀P) →

                  (∀ (y : G), 0 < μ' {y}) ∧ KL[X ; μ # Prod.fst + Prod.snd ; μ'.prod (uniformOn ↑A)] < r := sorry
